note: Iran: visa exemptions by nationality (90 days for Türkiye, 90 in six months for Armenia, Oman and Syria, down to 14 days for Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Malaysia and Russia); Lebanese take a visa on arrival since May 2026; nationals of Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Canada, Colombia, Jordan, Pakistan, Somalia, the UK and the US need a visa from a mission (the British, American and Canadian only with a certified guide), as do Israel's, whose passports Iran doesn't admit; everyone else applies for an e-Visa online, issued on arrival for 30 days. The free trade zones' 14 days aren't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter Iran without a visa for business or tourist purposes for the following period (unless otherwise noted): 90 days Turkey 90 days within any 6 months Armenia Oman Syria 45 days Georgia 30 days Iraq 30 days within any 90 days Tajikistan 21 days China Hong Kong Macau 20 days Egypt 15 days Venezuela 15 days within any 6 months Gulf Cooperation Council member states (except Oman) Belarus Bosnia and Herzegovina Brazil Brunei Cambodia Croatia Cuba Indonesia Japan Kyrgyzstan Lebanon Mauritania Mauritius Mexico Peru Serbia Seychelles Singapore Tanzania Tunisia Uzbekistan Vietnam Zimbabwe 14 days Azerbaijan Kazakhstan Malaysia Russia ... On May 4, 2026, the Iranian Embassy in Lebanon announced on X that citizens of Lebanon require a visa to enter Iran. Therefore, they must obtain a visa upon arrival at all of Iran's borders. ... Citizens of other countries must apply an e-Visa on the basis of which a visa on arrival will be issued for a maximum of 30 days ... Citizens of the following countries are ineligible for an e-Visa, and thus must obtain a visa in advance at an Iranian embassy or consulate: Afghanistan Bangladesh Canada Colombia Jordan Pakistan Somalia United Kingdom United States
